negative_reviews.author: James Newman
negative_reviews.text: Very poor service. One dish arrived 15 minutes before everyone else. Second dish arrived 8 minutes before the last two. Starters all arrived after mains and one starter necee arrived at all. Had to ask twice to amend the bill.

negative_reviews.author: Win Ho
negative_reviews.text:
The floor was quite slippery, so I raised the issue with the manager as I was concerned about the potential safety risk.

Unfortunately, his response was rather dismissive. He jokingly suggested that I only found the floor slippery because I was wearing expensive shoes, whereas he was wearing cheaper shoes and didn't find it slippery.

I wasn't bringing this up to complain about my shoes. I was simply concerned that the floor could be a safety hazard for customers. I found his response disappointing, as he seemed to brush off a genuine safety concern rather than take it seriously.

issues: Teddy's visit found prep not ready at 5:30pm: too little miso and curry sauce, and squid still uncut and being cut during service, with heads and edges binned and clumpy wet coating flour (Site Visit Report M10, 21/11).
The fryer oil was very dark with bits floating and the baskets caked, and the wok has black build up flaking at the edges.
Sliced beef was overcooked, cut too small and about two days old with loose vacuum bags; the rice was drying out and the rice cooker pot is badly scratched.
Specs were off: mixed sauces on the vegan roll, too much kimchi, cabbage cooked without onion and carrot, yakisoba cooked on too low a flame, unevenly coloured eggs and a low broth pot.
The wrong edamame was delivered, there is far too much vegan tonkatsu in stock, dry ice boxes are blocking the fridge, bananas were going black in the fridge and several freezers are half empty.
The sticky note wall was praised as the standard for every site.
Meat slicer distribution issues were raised for M9, M10 and M21 (Admin Meeting 23/11).
Ross completed the Leeds repairs (Ross Ward weekly report w/c 16/11).
